question: Does a one-reference search over the uncertain part of O3b concentrate volunteer-supported rare glitches that neither Gravity Spy CNN labeled as that type?

arms.hybrid: 0.5 s single view: mean of per-reference z of raw pixels (per-image z) and random1403 four-layer mix (v0.4 per-feature rule)
arms.random: 0.5 s single view: random2026 four-layer mix
arms.trained: 0.5 s single view: spectro_family_e8 coarse 6x6 grid

primary.subset: pool events whose O3b ml_label != type
primary.rule: POSITIVE only if, in at least 2 of the 3 primary types, the hypergeometric tail probability of the hybrid top-200 new_majority count (within the evaluated subset, on that ranking's own covered events) is below 0.05/3 AND the hybrid new_majority@200 counted per 4 s group exceeds the CNN P(type) comparator's on the same subset and K. Otherwise "not confirmed". Chirp is descriptive until an injection cross-match exists; Wandering_Line has too few volunteer-majority events (4 pool-wide).

score: v0.4 Bank vectors; per-reference z against 600 unlabeled v1.1 train images; mean over the five references of a type; descending stable sort, ties by roster order

pool.rule: ml_confidence < 0.7 OR (ml_label != r AND P(r) >= 0.3) for r in rare types

arrays.blank_rule: arrays with max minus min <= 1e-6 are dropped (reason "blank")

truth_tiers.supported: p >= 1 and p >= ceil(n/2); single volunteer when n <= 2

verification.new_rule: tier holds AND O3b-table ml_label != type AND volunteer-file ml_label != type; vocabulary-gap share (O3b label in Fast_Scattering/Blip_Low_Frequency) reported
verification.covered: event has at least one volunteer row; prior-only rows are uncovered
verification.evaluated_subset: per type, pool events with O3b ml_label != type; full pool secondary
verification.null: hypergeometric on each ranking: N = covered eligible pool events, M = pool-wide new_<tier> count, n = covered events in the top-K, x = observed
verification.tie_rule: descending score, stable sort, ties by roster order; CNN comparator sorted the same way on P(type)
verification.groups: counts also given per 4 s time group (pool_roster.csv group column)
verification.uncovered: top-K events without volunteer data are exported as candidates and count as zero finds

pre_freeze_disclosure.note: Per-event volunteer picks for the five rare types over the whole pool were extracted and seen before this protocol was written; the type list, K and truth tiers were chosen with these ceilings known. The search itself reads no labels.
